ex.question: When was the Eiffel Tower built, how tall is it, and who designed it?
ex.answer:
The Eiffel Tower was constructed between January 1887 and March 31, 1889, taking 2 years, 2 months and 5 days to complete [1] [2]. It was built as the centerpiece of the 1889 Exposition Universelle, the World's Fair celebrating the centenary of the French Revolution [3] [4].

When completed, the tower stood 300 meters (984 feet) tall, making it the tallest man-made structure in the world for 41 years [5]. Today it measures 330 meters (1,083 feet) thanks to broadcast antennas that have been added over the years [6] [7].

The Eiffel Tower was designed and built by **Gustave Eiffel**, a French civil engineer. His company designed and constructed the tower and it was named in his honor [8] [9]. Eiffel personally led a group of government officials to the top of the tower on the day of completion, climbing the 1,710 steps since the lifts were not yet operational [10].
